title: Story package — the Story Forge / Image Forge boundary contract
description: reports/package.json — a fully self-contained handoff. Image Forge consumes this single file and must never read Story Forge's internal state (scenes/, prompts/, context/). Everything needed to generate, validate, and regenerate every image is embedded.

story_id.description: Currently equals project_id; diverges if a project ever holds multiple stories

visual_bible.description: The full visual bible, embedded (see visual-bible.schema.json)

caption.description: Overlay text for downstream modules; the image itself contains no text

lighting.description: Time of day, weather, and the location's lighting character

character_references.description: Full character-bible entries for every character in this scene, embedded

object_references.description: Full object-bible entries plus this scene's object state, embedded

must_match.description: Facts a regenerated image must not contradict

neighbours.description: scene_ids whose images this one must stay visually continuous with

sources.description: Traceability only — project-relative paths of the files this package was assembled from. Image Forge must not read them.
